description: Revised diagnosis: CHW delta-T 19.8F is a LOW-FLOW signature, not proof of healthy coil. Suspect clogged CHW strainer at the coil (valve 100%, some flow, wide delta-T, DAT 66F). Plan: verify dP across Y-strainer, blowdown/clean screen, then watch DAT drop and delta-T narrow toward 10-14F design. Related WOs: #400117 (2504B 75.5F, High, due 7/3), #400169 (2504D 74F constant). Rm 2513A hit 85.2F overnight. Note: CWP-15 bad impeller (WO #399591) may be shedding debris loop-wide — check nearby strainers. Separate task from #400169: push occupancy setbacks later for 2504 suite (Mimi request).

action: HVAC team unclogged the CHW coil strainer
outcome: Watching DAT + CHW delta-T. Confirm delta-T narrows toward 10-14F design (was 19.8F = low flow). If delta-T stays wide, look upstream at pumps 3&4 in B50 B-101-A. Release cooling valve override, confirm modulation off 100%. Closes WOs 400117/400169 once 2504B/2504D/2513A recover. Follow debris trail: check B55 AHU-4 strainer (cmd100/pos0) + B50 AHU-1/2 on shared CHW system. CWP-15 bad impeller likely shedding debris loop-wide.

description: 7/2 09:00 DAT sweep: 9 critical, 17 high (worse than 7/1 PM). KEY CORRECTION: real B55 AHU-3 (object 1055059CGE, SNE-01) is 72.9F, UP from 66.3F despite strainer clean this morning - fix did not resolve it, or a plant issue dominates. The unit shown in the earlier Focus screenshot (1053120CGE, labeled B53 AHU-3, valve cmd/pos mismatches, high discharge humidity) is a SEPARATE object also on JL-BLDG55-SNE01 - confirm on-site which physical unit had the strainer job. NEW SEVERE: B6 AHU-1 spiked 61.3->85.7F (+30.7) - matches predicted SNE11 OAT lockout from 7/1. B28 AHU-3/4/7/11 all worse (OAT+CHW override applied to AHU-6 not yet applied to siblings on NAE28). B1 AHU-16/AHU-1 Dirty/AHU-3 all worse (SNE14 lockout still unresolved). B64 AHU-1/2 still high - confirm override status.

CORRECTION: OAT+CHW-Enable override does NOT appear to fix B28 AHU-3/4/7/11 (team reports never worked). These units already show cooling valves pinned near 100% in the valve sweep BEFORE any override - the blocker is not CHW System Enable, it is plant capacity (CHW supply temp or flow). AHU-6 apparent improvement (82.9->70.4) may be normal load easing, not proof the override worked. Decisive test going forward: check CHW SUPPLY TEMP AT THE PLANT SOURCE (not per-AHU) before applying more per-unit overrides. If supply temp is warm, escalate CWP-15 (WO 399591, bad impeller) instead of touching more Metasys points. Reserve the OAT-lockout override theory for units with a SUDDEN spike (like B6 AHU-1, 61->85F overnight) rather than chronically high units with maxed valves.

CHW readings post-strainer-clean: supply 46.9F, return 71.0F, delta-T 24.1F - WORSE than pre-clean 19.8F, not better. Supply temp is fine (plant delivering cold water OK to this branch: AHU-1 supply 43.5F dT13.2 good, AHU-4 supply 46.3F dT9.3 good) - rules out shared-pump-capacity theory for THIS unit, restriction is local to AHU-3. Next checks: (1) isolation valves fully reopened after strainer work, (2) air lock in coil - bleed it, (3) strainer may have refouled already if debris still shedding into loop, (4) strainer basket reseated correctly. Separate unrelated finding: AHU-4 CHW delta-T 9.3F is actually GOOD/tight - drop earlier theory that AHU-4 needs a strainer clean, its DAT rise (56.8->62.0F) is not a flow problem. AHU-2 CHW Supply Temp reads 140.3F - impossible/bad sensor, needs a WO, but DAT is fine (57.3F) so not urgent.

7/2 10:30 DAT sweep vs 09:00: B6 AHU-1 major improvement 85.7->68.4F (-17.3F), still critical but trending fast - confirms genuine sensor/lockout fault, fix is working. B55 AHU-3 modest improvement 72.9->71.0F despite CHW delta-T reading appearing frozen at 24.1F (needs a fresh, confirmed-live delta-T pull). B28 NAE-28 cluster (AHU-3/4/6/7/11) completely flat - reconfirms plant-capacity diagnosis, no further per-unit action useful. B64 AHU-1/2 unchanged (+7.4/+4.7) - confirm whether OAT+CHW override was actually applied this AM. B1 AHU-1 Dirty creeping toward critical (+9.4->+9.7). Still 9 critical, 17 high overall - same count as 09:00 but composition shifting (B6 improving, others flat).
Deferred - team will check OAT+CHW override status later today. Still +7.4/+4.7F over SP as of 10:30, unchanged since AM. Not forgotten, just not next.
